types.name: MarqueeProps
types.doc: An endless scroller for logos, quotes or tickers. The content repeats as often as needed to fill the track and loops without a seam. Hovering or focusing it eases the motion to a stop instead of freezing it, and it rests while off screen. With reduced motion it does not move on its own: the track becomes an ordinary scroll area.

members.name: children
members.doc: The items to scroll. They are laid out in a row, or in a column for the vertical directions.

members.name: direction
members.doc: Where the content travels. `left` and `right` scroll a row; `up` and `down` scroll a column and need a height on the marquee.

members.name: speed
members.doc: Travel speed in px per second.

members.name: gap
members.doc: Space between items, and between one repetition and the next, in px or any CSS length.

members.name: pauseOnHover
members.doc: Slows to a stop while the pointer is over the marquee or focus is inside it.

members.name: paused
members.doc: Stops the motion, for a pause button. People must be able to stop content that moves for more than a few seconds.

members.name: fade
members.doc: Fades the two edges the content enters and leaves through. Pass a CSS length to set how wide the fade is.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name for the group, for example "Customers".

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class names for the root element.

members.name: style
members.doc: Inline styles for the root element, for sizes and CSS variables.
